figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Electrochemically driven enzymatic oxidative desymmetrization. (A) Representative biocatalytic strategies for asymmetric synthesis of
axially chiral compounds. (B) Combining biocatalysis and electrochemistry to unlock unnatural enzyme function. (C) Proposed mechanism for
electroenzymatic oxidative desymmetrization. IREDs, imine reductases; ADHs, alcohol dehydrogenases; KREDs, ketoreductases; GOases, galactose
oxidases; DKR, dynamic kinetic resolution; SET, single electron transfer.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Reaction development. (A) Optimal reaction conditions and the variations. (B) Electrolysis setup (0.15 mmol (43 mg) and 1.0 mmol (288
mg) scale) for the scale synthesis of 2a. (C) Trajectory of evolution. (D) Sites selected for evolution based on a docked intermediate within the active
site of Pf BAL. aThe enzyme loading was determined to be 1 mol % when measured by the A280 method, and 0.60−0.65 mol % by the Bradford assay
(see Table S1 for details). All enzyme loading data presented in the main text are based on the A280 method. bCondition A: 1a (0.008 mmol, 2.3 mg),
PfBAL mutant (1 mol %), ThDP (25 mol %), FcMeOH (10 mol % for PfBAL-M1 and 50 mol % for Pf BAL-M2), DMSO (20 v/v%) in TEOA buffer
(50 mM, pH = 8.0, containing 3.75 mM MgSO4), 0.4 mA constant current, 8 F mol−1 (around 6 h), graphite electrodes, undivided cell and total volume
of reaction was 2.5 mL. cYield (average of duplicate measurements) was determined by reverse phase HPLC with biphenyl as the internal standard.
dEnantiomeric ratio was determined by HPLC analysis on a chiral stationary phase. eOther mediators and chemical oxidants (see Tables S24 and S27
for details). fScale-up reactions (see Supporting Information Section 4 for details). gCondition B: 1a (0.004 mmol, 1.2 mg), Pf BAL mutant (1 mol %),
ThDP (20 mol %), FcMeOH (100 mol %), DMSO (15 v/v%) in MOPS buffer (50 mM, pH = 6.5, containing 2.5 mM MgSO4), 0.4 mA constant
current, 6 F mol−1 (around 4.5 h), graphite electrodes, undivided cell and total volume of reaction was 3.0 mL. PfBAL-M1, Pf BAL-A28G-E553L;
PfBAL-M2, Pf BAL-H29A-F484G; FcMeOH, Ferrocenemethanol; ηF, Faraday efficiency (equals the theoretical charge required divided by the actual
charge consumed, multiplied by the yield).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Scope investigation. Standard conditions: 1 (0.008 mmol), PfBAL variant (1 mol %), ThDP (25 mol %), FcMeOH (10 mol % for Pf BAL-
M1 and 50 mol % for Pf BAL-M2), DMSO (20 v/v%) in TEOA buffer (50 mM, pH = 8.0, containing 3.75 mM MgSO4), 0.4 mA constant current, 8 F
mol−1, graphite electrodes, undivided cell and total volume of reaction was 2.5 mL. Yield was determined by reverse phase HPLC as the average of
duplicates. Enantiomeric ratio was determined by HPLC analysis on a chiral stationary phase. The absolute configuration of 2a was assigned as (S) by
single-crystal X-ray diffraction analysis.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Mechanistic studies. (A) UV−vis absorption spectra. 1a (0.8 mM), PfBAL-M1 (0.032 mM). (B) Cyclic voltammetry curves of the mixture of
0.032 mM PfBAL-M1 and 3.2 mM 1a (violet), 0.32 mM FcMeOH (gray), the mixture of 1a and FcMeOH (green), the mixture of Pf BAL-M1 and
FcMeOH (red), as well as the mixture of Pf BAL-M1, 1a and FcMeOH (blue) in a solvent mixture of TEOA buffer (50 mM, pH = 8.0, containing 1.0
mM ThDP and 3.75 mM MgSO4)/DMSO (20 v/v%). Scan rate: 5 mV s−1. (C) Low temperature EPR experiments. Standard conditions: 1a (0.008
mmol), PfBAL mutant (1 mol %), FcMeOH (10 mol % for Pf BAL-M1 and 50 mol % for PfBAL-M2) in a solvent mixture of TEOA buffer (50 mM, pH
= 8.0, containing 1.0 mM ThDP and 3.75 mM MgSO4)/DMSO (20 v/v%), total volume of the reaction was 2.5 mL. The reaction mixture was
operated at a constant current of 0.4 mA and equipped with a graphite anode and a graphite cathode. EPR parameters: microwave frequency, 9.4 GHz;
microwave power, 2.0 mW; temperature, 100 K. (D) Isotope labeling experiment of 1l. (E) Selected molecular dynamics snapshot (t = 200 ns) and
calculated binding free energies (kcal mol−1) of (S)-Int. A and (R)-Int. A with Pf BAL-M1 and Pf BAL-M2 as the enzyme, distances were given in Å.
(F) Isotope labeling experiments of 1a, 2a and electrolysis of the product. HRMS, high-resolution mass spectrometry; LCMS, liquid chromatography−
mass spectrometry.
